title: Require Workstream Plugin Pack Hook Configuration
forbids: checked-in workstream hook configuration whose SessionStart or Stop event does not invoke the canonical workstream-plugin-pack hook source
why: Checked-in hook configuration projects the pack's canonical startup and closure behavior directly. Parser-visible configuration relationships prevent copied hooks and alternate runtime sources without moving operational hook behavior into policy code.
remediate: Point SessionStart to tools/workstream-plugin-pack/hooks/workstream_startup.ts and Stop to tools/workstream-plugin-pack/hooks/workstream_closure_guard.ts through the canonical repository-root command.
message: Checked-in workstream hook configuration must target the canonical pack hook sources.
